purpose: Proves gin.DetectLibraryEntryPoint's exact boundary: a function that registers routes on a router-typed parameter and is NEVER called anywhere in the module produces a gin-library-entry-point diagnostic (routes genuinely unresolvable from this module alone), while an identically-shaped function that IS called from a real entry point within the same module does not — that case is already correctly resolved via ordinary registrar-following.

expectedRoutes.note: CalledInit is reached via WiredUp's gin.New(); fully resolved.

expectedUnresolved.note: Registers POST /webhooks/uncalled but is never called anywhere in this module.
